about: Split calls from the first look of wave 14.

listings.note: Three places on separate fingers of the lake: loop G in the north, loop A in the east, loops D to F on the south point, and group site B alone in the woods.
Group sites G2 to G5 sit 900 m west of the loops in the forest, apart from the campground on the river.
Three places on separate fingers of the lake: 080 to 104 in the west, 035 to 079 in the middle, 001 to 034 on the east point (gap 150 m to part the west two).
